quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Jellyfish!
quests.question: j
quests.hint: Think of Jellyfish — that's what this letter starts! 🪼
quests.explanation: Great work! j is the letter that starts Jellyfish. 🪼
quests.funFact: Jellyfish don't have brains, hearts, or bones, and are 95% water!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Kangaroo!
quests.question: k
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with two small legs kicking out.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — k starts the word Kangaroo.
quests.funFact: Kangaroos use their strong tails for balance, so if you lift their tail, they can't hop!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Lemon!
quests.question: l
quests.hint: Think of Lemon — that's what this letter starts! 🍋
quests.explanation: Great work! l is the letter that starts Lemon. 🍋
quests.funFact: Lemons contain more sugar than strawberries!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Moon!
quests.question: M
quests.hint: Think of Moon — that's what this letter starts! 🌙
quests.explanation: Great work! M is the letter that starts Moon. 🌙
quests.funFact: The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth by about an inch every year!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Nose!
quests.question: N
quests.hint: It has two tall lines joined by a slanted line between them.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — N starts the word Nose.
quests.funFact: Your nose can remember up to 50,000 different scents!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Octopus!
quests.question: O
quests.hint: Think of Octopus — that's what this letter starts! 🐙
quests.explanation: Great work! O is the letter that starts Octopus. 🐙
quests.funFact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Pizza!
quests.question: p
quests.hint: Think of Pizza — that's what this letter starts! 🍕
quests.explanation: Great work! p is the letter that starts Pizza. 🍕
quests.funFact: The first pizza was created in Naples, Italy, in the 1800s!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Quail!
quests.question: q
quests.hint: It has a small circle with a short tail that dips below the line.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — q starts the word Quail.
quests.funFact: Quails love to take 'dust baths' to keep their feathers clean!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Rainbow!
quests.question: r
quests.hint: Think of Rainbow — that's what this letter starts! 🌈
quests.explanation: Great work! r is the letter that starts Rainbow. 🌈
quests.funFact: You can only see a rainbow if the sun is completely behind you!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Snake!
quests.question: S
quests.hint: Think of Snake — that's what this letter starts! 🐍
quests.explanation: Great work! S is the letter that starts Snake. 🐍
quests.funFact: Snakes can't blink because they don't have eyelids!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Train!
quests.question: T
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with a flat line across the top, like a hat.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — T starts the word Train.
quests.funFact: The fastest train in the world can travel over 280 miles per hour!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word UFO!
quests.question: U
quests.hint: Think of UFO — that's what this letter starts! 🛸
quests.explanation: Great work! U is the letter that starts UFO. 🛸
quests.funFact: The term UFO was coined by the US Air Force in 1952!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Violin!
quests.question: v
quests.hint: Think of Violin — that's what this letter starts! 🎻
quests.explanation: Great work! v is the letter that starts Violin. 🎻
quests.funFact: Playing the violin burns about 170 calories an hour!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Wolf!
quests.question: w
quests.hint: It has four short lines dipping up and down, like two v's together.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — w starts the word Wolf.
quests.funFact: Wolves have webbed toes to help them swim and walk on snow easily!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Xenops!
quests.question: x
quests.hint: Think of Xenops — that's what this letter starts! 🐦
quests.explanation: Great work! x is the letter that starts Xenops. 🐦
quests.funFact: The xenops is a rainforest bird that loves to hang upside down while eating!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Yarn!
quests.question: Y
quests.hint: Think of Yarn — that's what this letter starts! 🧶
quests.explanation: Great work! Y is the letter that starts Yarn. 🧶
quests.funFact: A single ball of yarn can contain over 200 yards of wool!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Zipper!
quests.question: Z
quests.hint: It has a zigzag line -- straight, slanted, then straight again.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — Z starts the word Zipper.
quests.funFact: The first zippers were used only for boots and tobacco pouches!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Alligator!
quests.question: A
quests.hint: Think of Alligator — that's what this letter starts! 🐊
quests.explanation: Great work! A is the letter that starts Alligator. 🐊
quests.funFact: Alligators can go through 3,000 teeth in their lifetime!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Butterfly!
quests.question: b
quests.hint: Think of Butterfly — that's what this letter starts! ⚽
quests.explanation: Great work! b is the letter that starts Butterfly. 🦋
quests.funFact: Butterflies taste with their feet instead of their mouths!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Castle!
quests.question: c
quests.hint: It has a curved line, open on the right, like a little moon.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — c starts the word Castle.
quests.funFact: The oldest inhabited castle in the world is Windsor Castle in England!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Drum!
quests.question: d
quests.hint: It has a small circle with a tall straight line on the right side.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — d starts the word Drum.
quests.funFact: Drums are the world's oldest and most common musical instruments!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Egg!
quests.question: E
quests.hint: Think of Egg — that's what this letter starts! 🥚
quests.explanation: Great work! E is the letter that starts Egg. 🥚
quests.funFact: The color of a hen's earlobe can tell you what color egg she will lay!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Firetruck!
quests.question: F
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with two short lines on top, like E without its bottom shelf.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — F starts the word Firetruck.
quests.funFact: Early firetrucks were actually pulled by horses, not engines!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Gorilla!
quests.question: G
quests.hint: It has a big curved line like C, with a small hook at the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — G starts the word Gorilla.
quests.funFact: Gorillas can learn sign language and communicate with humans!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Helicopter!
quests.question: h
quests.hint: Think of Helicopter — tHelicopter's wHelicopter this letter starts! 🚁
quests.explanation: Great work! h is the letter tHelicopter starts Helicopter. 🚁
quests.funFact: A helicopter can fly backwards, forwards, and even side-to-side!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Island!
quests.question: i
quests.hint: It has a short straight line with a small dot on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — i starts the word Island.
quests.funFact: The world's largest island is Greenland!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter that starts the word Jaguar!
quests.question: j
quests.hint: It has a curved hook with a small dot on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — j starts the word Jaguar.
quests.funFact: Jaguars are excellent swimmers and love to play in the water!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Koala!
quests.question: K
quests.hint: Think of Koala — that's what this letter starts! 🐨
quests.explanation: Great work! K is the letter that starts Koala. 🐨
quests.funFact: Koalas sleep for up to 22 hours a day!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Lizard!
quests.question: L
quests.hint: It has a tall straight line with a short line along the bottom, like a foot.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — L starts the word Lizard.
quests.funFact: Some lizards can detach their tails to escape predators, and it grows back later!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter that starts the word Mountain!
quests.question: M
quests.hint: It has two tall lines with a peak dipping down between them, like mountains.
quests.explanation: Well done! You know your letters — M starts the word Mountain.
quests.funFact: Mount Everest, the tallest mountain, grows about a quarter of an inch every year!
